analyst.text: Dallas are framed as 'ahead of schedule' under first-year coach Dusty May, with Kyrie Irving back, but they play the second night of a back-to-back. Utah lost to Phoenix after briefly breaking a 12-game skid, with Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. out without timelines. Rookie Darryn Peterson is being managed carefully. The owner says Will Hardy's job is safe. The angle leans slightly towards Dallas.
